summary: Iter49 — Design-file report / admin moderation queue (stolen / IP issue). Fully tested E2E on backend (pytest 14/14 PASS) and frontend (Community report flow + Admin File Reports tab with Open/Resolved/Dismissed filters, Quarantine / Dismiss / Restore). Public list correctly excludes quarantined files and re-includes after unquarantine. Dedup on same-user same-file report returns duplicate=true with original id, and the frontend surfaces the intended copy ('You already reported this file — the admin team has it.').

issues: When a buyer JWT is set in localStorage but /community/me has not yet resolved (or returns 401), the page aggressively deletes cm_buyer_jwt — the top-right still shows 'SIGN IN' even when localStorage had a valid token a second earlier. This is pre-existing (carried over from iter48) and documented in the previous test report. Real buyers who magic-link-verify first create a community_users row so don't see this; it only trips automated tests using synthetic JWTs. Mitigation: seed a community_users row before the UI test.

critical_code_review_comments: [cosmetic] /api/admin/design-files/reports returns full report list (up to 500) including potentially PII-sensitive `reported_by` user ids. This is correct for an admin queue but worth noting — don't accidentally expose via any non-admin endpoint. Currently protected by current_admin dependency, OK.

[cosmetic] admin.py:1916 resets open_reports counter to 0 on quarantine. That's correct if *all* open reports are rolled up simultaneously (which the update_many below does), but if a new report arrives *between* the two awaits (tiny race), its $inc open_reports would push counter to 1 while the file is already quarantined. Extremely narrow race — no fix needed, but a single pipeline update or a post-increment clamp would be cleaner.

[cosmetic] CommunityPage.jsx:590 canReport is evaluated once per render from localStorage synchronously — OK functionally, but since useEffect on mount can call /community/me and remove cm_buyer_jwt on a 401, canReport can momentarily show Report buttons for an invalid session. The POST /report would then return 401 and the modal would show a generic failure. Consider gating canReport on both localStorage AND a boolean hydrated after the first /community/me round-trip.

[cosmetic] Modal close-on-backdrop-click uses `if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !busy) onClose();`. Good UX. The '✕' button has an aria-label but the modal container lacks role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'. Minor a11y polish.
[no-fix-needed] Frontend ReportFileModal success state says 'the admin team will review this within 24h' — make sure your SLA actually supports that promise; otherwise soften the copy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — buyer Report + dedup + admin Open/Dismiss/Quarantine/Restore all PASS

test_credentials: Admin JWT / Buyer JWT / second Buyer JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt (commands in review_request). Buyer JWT requires a pre-existing community_users row OR the page's useEffect will delete the JWT from localStorage when /community/me 401s — for UI tests, upsert `community_users` row with user_id matching JWT sub before loading the page.
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned 1 design_files row (TEST_iter49_report_target) + multiple design_file_reports rows from pytest fixture teardown. Created + deleted 1 community_users row (test-buyer-iter49). Residual: the 4 original manual-curl reports from the handoff (buyer-contributed svg + test svg upload etc.) are still present in Mongo — 1 was dismissed during UI test, 1 was quarantined-then-restored; they can be purged by main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key testids used: file-report-btn-{id}, report-file-modal, report-file-reason (select), report-file-details (textarea), report-file-submit (red btn), report-file-success (success/duplicate div), report-file-done-close (Close link inside success), report-file-close (✕), admin-tab-file-reports, file-reports-filter-{open|resolved|dismissed}, file-report-row-{id}, file-report-preview-{id}, file-report-quarantine-{id}, file-report-dismiss-{id}, file-report-restore-{id}. TRICK: admin page redirects to /admin/login if cm_admin_jwt absent, so navigate to /admin/login FIRST, set localStorage, then goto /admin/dashboard. For buyer UI tests, upsert community_users row (user_id=JWT sub) BEFORE opening /community — otherwise useEffect deletes the JWT.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature is working. One flaky first-run observation during UI testing: setting cm_buyer_jwt then reloading /community deleted the jwt from localStorage because /community/me returned 401 (no community_users row for synthetic test sub). Root cause: CommunityPage.jsx:52-60 aggressively removes the jwt on any /me error. Fix applied (test-side only): upserted a community_users row for the test buyer before reload. Cleaned it up after test. No product code changed — this is the same gating intent documented in the iter48 retrospective and is by design for production users.
